import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n, x = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    cost = data[2:2 + n]
    MOD = 1_000_000_007
    pw = [1] * n
    for i in range(1, n):
        pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 2 % MOD
    rem, ans = x, 0
    # Greedy from the highest index: 2^i beats all lower profits combined.
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        c = int(cost[i])
        if c <= rem:
            rem -= c
            ans += pw[i]
    print(ans % MOD)


main()
